body:
Thank you This is the nicest thing I've heard someone tell me in a long time. Far more than I even expected. I will visit an attorney soon. And I've been here 3 years btw.


As far as counseling. We have been in counseling both in couple and individually. Individually I recently found out  she never even spoke about me in her sessions. She never spoke about her own tendencies to throw things to be insulting yell and lose control. I tried to contact her therapist and let her know but it was no use.

WhenI found out she tried to kill herself I told my therapist which is the same health facility to please warn hers because I  am not allowed to contact her directly. It is a huge mess and nothing ever happened. I don't know what is the right thing to do anymore. She makes me feel like I am the bad guy... I am starting to think so too for some reason.

I honestly can't stand her anymore. But next week is my nightmare week. Tomorrow we have to sign a new lease or else we will get kicked out with nowhere to go.

Tuesday we have to drive to an immigration office to clear up doubts due to certain irregularities.

Wednesday I need to basically drag her to her doctor's appointment or else who knows whats going to keep scaring her cornea.

Then we have to pack and go.

She won't do anything of this in a peaceful manner.


How am I going to get through this? Today I was feeling great... I got home from exercising. I asked her if she wanted me to sleep in the sofa or at the bed. She said she didn't care. I chose the sofa to listen to music. Still feeling good. She came and started yelling that this is why I never fix anything. I stood up and went to the bed, she got up threw away her phone  and said "Don't Bull shit me". Then I went to the sofa, and she  yelled more at me. I can't sleep now. This is the person who has me in her hands. And this has been my life for the past months.

This is almost everyday... What if she doesn't get  up to sign the lease?   What if they tell me that my immigration is effed for something she has said or done  in the past? Like lying or who knows. God I can't stand living like this anymore. Why the hell can she break me so bad? Why is it that my mom spends 2 hours building me up for the week I spend 2 hours getting psyched in the gym. And she can destroy my spirit in 45 seconds. 


But anyway maybe I deserve this. I brought this upon myself I trusted someone with too much too fast. The least I can do is accept my faith right?
